_help: VARCO 3D 생성 명세 (MCP: TextInput -> GenerateImage -> Generate3D [-> Rig -> Animate]). flow_id는 이 프로젝트 전용 플로우 ID (사용자가 VARCO에서 새로 만든 뒤 기록, 다른 프로젝트 플로우 재사용 금지). polygon_count는 목표 삼각형 수, texture_size는 텍스처 해상도. Git LFS 없이 올리기 위해 파일 1개당 15MB 이하. status: pending | generated | failed | blocked. calls.image 최대 3, calls.mesh 최대 2. 움직이는 캐릭터는 rig(humanoid | humanoid-fingers | quadruped)와 animations(get_animation_catalog의 key 목록)를 넣는다.

defaults.style_suffix: stylized cartoon game asset, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, single object only, nothing else in the image, isolated on a plain seamless light gray studio background, full view, centered, 3/4 view
defaults.tpose_suffix: stylized cartoon game character, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, standing in a T-pose, both arms stretched straight out horizontally, legs straight and slightly apart, empty hands, single object only, nothing else in the image, isolated on a plain seamless light gray studio background, front view, full view head to feet, centered

assets.name: 조선 협객 (1인칭 전신)
assets.prompt: young Joseon dynasty Korean martial artist, white jeogori jacket, black fitted martial arts pants tied at the ankles, black cloth wrist wraps, straw sandals, hair tied in a topknot with a headband
assets.notes: 1인칭 전신. 손이 화면에 보이므로 humanoid-fingers. 머리는 게임에서 ShadowsOnly. 부족한 파쿠르/회피/찌르기/칼뺏기/윈드밀 동작은 Mixamo.

assets.name: 포졸 (칼)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean police soldier podol, black jeollip wide-brim hat with red tassel, red kwaeja sleeveless vest over dark jacket, black belt, black boots
assets.notes: 무기(weapon_sword)는 따로 만들어 오른손 뼈에 붙인다. 포위 전투에도 재사용.

assets.name: 포졸 (창)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean police soldier podol, black jeollip wide-brim hat with blue tassel, blue kwaeja sleeveless vest over dark jacket, black belt, black boots
assets.notes: 무기(weapon_spear)는 따로 만들어 양손에 붙인다. 지붕에서 발차기에 맞아 떨어지는 동작은 struggle_fall.

assets.name: 무사 (최종 적)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean general warrior, dark red dujeonggap studded armor coat, iron helmet with plume, black boots, imposing build
assets.notes: 공격 5회 콤보는 여러 클립을 Animator 크로스페이드로 잇는다.

assets.name: 환도
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon hwando single-edged slightly curved sword, black lacquered scabbard-less blade with round guard and wrapped handle, lying horizontally
assets.notes: height_m은 길이. 칼 뺏기 연출에서 플레이어 손으로 옮긴다.

assets.name: 창
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon dynasty spear, long wooden shaft, steel spearhead with red tassel below the blade, lying horizontally

assets.name: 기와집
assets.prompt: traditional Korean hanok house with curved dark gray giwa tile roof, white plaster walls, wooden pillars and lattice doors, stone foundation
assets.notes: 지붕 위를 달린다. 충돌은 Unity 기본 도형(박스)으로 따로 둔다.

assets.name: 돌담 한 칸
assets.prompt: traditional Korean stone wall segment, stacked stones with clay, small giwa tile cap on top, straight section 3 meters long
assets.notes: 길이 3 m로 맞춰 반복 배치. 벽타기용 높은 벽은 크기를 늘려 재사용.

assets.name: 성문 누각
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon fortress gate with stone arch base and wooden two-story pavilion on top, curved giwa tile roof, red wooden pillars, dancheong painted eaves
assets.notes: 마지막 결전 장소. 누각 위 바닥은 기본 도형으로 충돌 처리.

assets.name: 수레
assets.prompt: old wooden Korean hand cart with two large wooden wheels, loaded with straw sacks

assets.name: 항아리 더미
assets.prompt: cluster of traditional Korean brown onggi clay jars of different sizes with lids, grouped together
